name: Google Drive Slideshow
description: Shows one image at a time from a public Google Drive folder, advancing on a fixed time slot.

folderUrl.title: Folder URL or ID
folderUrl.description: Public Google Drive folder link from Share (paste the full URL when possible), or the raw folder ID. Sharing must be Anyone with the link can view.

folderResourceKey.title: Folder resource key
folderResourceKey.description: Optional. Required for some link-shared folders when you use only a folder ID, or when the share URL has no resourcekey query parameter. Copy it from the full Share link (?resourcekey=…) or leave empty if the folder URL already includes it.

apiKey.title: Google API key
apiKey.description: API key with the Google Drive API enabled. The key is sent only in POST requests to this integration's data adapter.

order.title: Photo order
order.description: Random picks a stable photo per time slot. Name, modified, and created rotate through the folder in that sort order.

slotMinutes.title: Minutes per photo
slotMinutes.description: Match your frame's synchronisation interval so each refresh shows the image for that time slot.

brightnessBoost.title: Brightness boost
brightnessBoost.description: Exposure lift for the e-ink frame.
